release_scope: portable numerical audit and sanitized producer source with immutable upstream and environment pins

checkpoint_policy.coverage: all base, specialist, adapter, primary-calibration, and composition-control dataset repositories used by v7
checkpoint_policy.historical_caveat: the B16 covariance manifest omitted its snapshot label; the two retained candidate base revisions have bitwise-identical weights and are content-hashed in the revision record

producer_source.identity: all released source files are pinned by RESULTS.sha256
producer_source.repository_identifier_policy: withheld for double-blind review; the complete source snapshot is included directly

headline_estimand.external_h0_policy: reported separately; never added to or subtracted from the fitted null

main_full_finetuning_exact.null: analytic scalar Haar expectation within every retained activation block and full complement
main_full_finetuning_exact.B16_B32_scope: 20 tasks x all 72 retained linear modules

lora_factor_null.pooling: arithmetic mean of the four per-row 16-draw null estimates
lora_factor_null.mc_uncertainty: sample SD across four independent batch estimates divided by sqrt(4), df=3
lora_factor_null.legacy_status: seed-0 16-draw audit only; not the primary paper estimate

lora_factor_audit.primary_scope: 8 tasks x 28 unordered pairs x all 24 q_proj/v_proj modules
lora_factor_audit.primary_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean over task-pair/module cells
lora_factor_audit.secondary_status: historical provenance diagnostic only; not the primary factor-audit estimand

merge_accuracy_evaluation.scope: fixed-rank empirical comparison; no general dominance claim

external_h0_diagnostics.scope: matched full-FT, LoRA, and linearized-LoRA arms

calibration_source_endpoint_subgroups.aggregation: equal row weights within endpoint-count subgroup; ratio of subgroup means
calibration_source_endpoint_subgroups.scope: descriptive gradient by calibration-source endpoint count, not a randomization or causal contrast

calibration_resampling_robustness.method: independent source-stratified nonparametric calibration resampling with replacement, followed by full covariance and exact-null refits
calibration_resampling_robustness.interval_scope: the two min-max values are an observed robustness range; the crossed intervals condition on each fitted covariance and are not calibration-resampling confidence intervals

calibration_composition_control.method: source-balanced simple random sample without replacement from three deliberately different cached test splits, followed by full covariance and exact-null refit
calibration_composition_control.interval_scope: finite-pool task-by-layer interval conditional on the alternative fitted covariance; not uncertainty over calibration compositions or superpopulation coverage
calibration_composition_control.license_note: source images are not redistributed; independently verify source terms before any redistribution

crossed_bootstrap.scope: finite-pool resampling/stability interval conditional on realized tasks, one checkpoint per task, calibration, and per-row null; not superpopulation coverage

legacy_lora_crossed_bootstrap.status: seed-0 16-draw audit only; superseded by the MC64 pooled bootstrap

projector_diagnostic.interpretation: observed-null basis overlap; not a causal inheritance estimate

leave_one_out_influence.task_omission: remove every row whose endpoint pair contains the task
leave_one_out_influence.layer_omission: remove every module in the encoder-layer index
leave_one_out_influence.aggregation: recompute the equal-cell ratio of means after each omission
